items.quote: the wrong price for a unit on a booking form—seven thousand dirhams off.
items.statement: She had mistakenly entered the wrong price for a unit on a booking form—seven thousand dirhams off.

items.quote: come clean. Not only did she admit her mistake, but she even sent the client screenshots
items.statement: She chose to come clean about her mistake and sent the client screenshots of missed messages.

items.quote: the client was so impressed by her honesty that he refused to let her cover the seven thousand
items.statement: The client was so impressed by her honesty that he refused to let her cover the seven thousand dirhams herself.

overview: A coaching success story illustrating the impact of a mindset shift in sales situations.
